column2:
• v. 作长途徒步旅行
    to take a long walk in the mountains or countryside
助记 穿着Nike鞋徒步旅行(hike)
例句
  • He wants to hike round the world.
    他打算徒步旅行环游世界一周。
搭配
  • price hike — 提价；物价上涨
  • take a hike — 走路；滚开；哪凉快那歇着去
  • hike up — 飘起
  • tax hike — 赋税增加
同根 hiking n. · hiker n.

• adj. 作为结果的；必然的
    happening as a result of a particular event or situation
助记 con ＋ sequ(跟随) ＋ ent(…的) → 随之发生的
例句
  • the rise in inflation and consequent fall in demand
    通货膨胀的加剧和随之而来的需求下降
搭配
  • consequent on — 随之而来；跟着…发生的
同根 consequential adj. · consequently adv. · consequence n.

• n. 庄重；尊严；体面
    the ability to behave in a calm controlled way even in a difficult situation
助记 dign(有价值的) ＋ ity → 高贵
真题
  • ...that these extracurricular jobs were an effort on the part of the workers to regain their dignity after suffering the degradation of repetitive assembly line work in the factory... 2013.6 阅读理解
例句
  • We do this because we believe in the dignity and value of every person.
    我们这样做是因为我们相信每个人的尊严和价值。
  • They have to be treated well, with dignity.
    必须善待申请人，让人有尊严。
同根 dignified adj. · dignified v. · dignify vt.

• adj. 最优的，最适宜的
    the best or most suitable for a particular purpose or in a particular situation
助记 optim(最好) ＋ um → 最好的 → 最适合的
例句
  • optimum conditions for growth
    最适宜生长的条件
搭配
  • optimum design — 最佳设计，最优设计
  • optimum condition — 最适条件；最佳工况
  • optimum solution — 最佳（优）解
  • optimum control — 最优控制；最佳控制
同根 optimal adj. · optimally adv. · optimization n.

• adj. 作为组成部分的；内置的
    provided as part of something, rather than being separate
助记 integr(整体) ＋ al(…的) → 构成整体的， 完整的 → 构成整体所必需的
真题
  • ...We see the potential for capture and storage to play an integral role in reducing emissions... 2012.6 阅读理解
例句
  • a TV and integral video recorder
    内置录像机的电视
搭配
  • integral part — 积分部分；整数部份；主要的部分
  • integral equation — 积分方程
  • integral method — 积分法
  • integral structure — 整体结构
同根 integrate adj. · integrated adj. · integrally adv. · integrity n. · integrate n. · integer n. · integrated v. · integrate vi.

• adj. 足够的；宽敞的
    more than enough
例句
  • There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun.
    将会有充足的机会来放松、游泳和接受一些阳光。
搭配
  • ample evidence — 充分证据
同根 amply adv. · ampleness n.

• n. 租约，契约，租契
    a legal agreement which allows you to use a building, car etc for a period of time, in return for rent
助记 l ＋ ease(安心) → 有了租约才安心 → 租约
例句
  • The landlord refused to renew his lease.
    房东拒绝和他续签租约。
  • The 99-year lease expired in 1999.
    99年期的租约于1999年到期。
搭配
  • lease contract — 租契；租赁契约
  • lease term — 租赁期
  • financial lease — 融资性租赁；财务租赁
  • land lease — 批地契约；土地批租；土地契约
同根 leased adj. · leased n. · leaseholder n. · leased v.

• v. 包租（飞机、船等）
    to pay a company for the use of their aircraft, boat etc
例句
  • We chartered a boat to take us to some of the smaller islands.
    我们包了一条船带我们到一些较小的岛上去。
搭配
  • charter party — 佣船契约；包船契约；租船方
  • olympic charter — 奥林匹克宪章
  • charter flight — 包机
  • time charter — 定期租船契约
同根 chartered adj. · chartist n. · chartism n. · chartered v.

• n. （机构或公司的）主管，经理
    a manager in an organization or company who helps make important decisions
真题
  • ...the founder and executive director of the program... 2017.6 阅读理解
  • ...chief executive officer of Sustainable Business Consulting... 2016.6 阅读理解
例句
  • a marketing executive
    营销主管
搭配
  • chief executive — 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
  • executive director — 执行理事；常务董事
  • executive committee — 执行委员会
  • executive officer — 主任参谋，执行官
同根 exec abbr. · executed adj. · executable adj. · executorial adj. · execution n. · executor n. · exec n. · executed v.

• n. 总管道，干线
    a large pipe or wire carrying the public supply of water, electricity, or gas
真题
  • ...the main task of vocational college is cultivating human resource with practical capability... 2017.6 写作题
  • ...Both attending a vocational college or a university serves as two main options for the high school graduates... 2017.6 写作题
例句
  • The report found that many of Yorkshire’s water mains needed replacing.
    报告中说约克郡的很多自来水总管道需要更换。
  • a burst gas main
    破裂的煤气总管道
搭配
  • main products — 主要产品
  • main body — 主体，主要部分；主船体；机身
  • main reason — 主要原因
  • main content — 主要内容
同根 mainly adv. · mainstay n. · mainspring n.

• adj. 总的
    You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something
真题
  • ...which typically rises faster than wages and the overall economy... 2016.6 阅读理解
  • ...and that it's related to the company's overall strategy... 2016.6 听力题
例句
  • ...the overall rise in unemployment.
    …失业人数的总体上升。
搭配
  • overall situation — 大局；总体形势
  • overall quality — 综合质量；总的质量
  • overall development — 综合开发
  • overall planning — 整体规划；全面规划
同根 overbearing adj. · overbearing v.

• adj. 紫外（线）的
    ultraviolet light cannot be seen by people, but is responsible for making your skin darker when you are in the sun
助记 ultra(超…的) ＋ violet(紫罗兰， 紫色) → 紫外线的
例句
  • The sun's ultraviolet rays are responsible for both tanning and burning.
    太阳的紫外线是皮肤晒黑和晒伤的原因。
搭配
  • ultraviolet radiation — 紫外线；紫外线照射
  • ultraviolet light — 紫外线
  • ultraviolet ray — 紫外线
  • ultraviolet irradiation — 紫外线照射

• v. 资助；赋予
    to give a college, hospital etc a large sum of money that provides it with an income
例句
  • The ambassador has endowed a $1 million public-service fellowships programme.
    大使资助了一个100万美元的公共服务奖学金项目。
  • You are endowed with wealth, good health and a lively intellect.
    你天生赋有财富、健康，和敏锐的智力。
搭配
  • endow with — 赋予；具有
同根 endowment n.

• n. 资格；学历
    if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject
例句
  • He left school without any qualifications.
    他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。
搭配
  • qualification certificate — 资格证书
  • professional qualification — 专业资格；职称等级
  • qualification test — 资格考试；合格试验；质量鉴定试验
  • procedure qualification — 工艺评定；程序评定
同根 qualified adj. · qualifying adj. · qualifier n. · qualified v. · qualify vi. · qualify vt.

• v. （发出巨响的） 猛撞
    If something crashes somewhere, it moves and hits something else violently, making a loud noise
助记 破裂声 → 碰撞
真题
  • ...Reports are coming in of a major train crash in Japan... 2009.6 听力题
例句
  • The door swung inwards to crash against a chest of drawers behind it.
    门摆向里面，砰的一声猛力撞上了门后的五斗橱。
  • My words were lost as the walls above us crashed down, filling the cellar with brick dust.
    随着上面的墙体轰隆一声倒塌下来，地窖里充满砖灰，我吓得说不出话来。
搭配
  • car crash — 车祸；汽车碰撞
  • air crash — 飞机失事
  • stock market crash — 股市崩盘；股市行情暴跌
  • crash course — 速成课（等于cram course）
同根 crashing adj. · crasher n. · crashing v.

• adj. 壮丽的；超等的
    extremely good
例句
  • The food was superb.
    食物好吃极了。
同根 super adj. · superbly adv. · super n.

• n. 装饰物
    a small object that you keep in your house because it is beautiful rather than useful
助记 orn(装饰) ＋ ament → 装饰
例句
  • a shelf covered with books and ornaments
    摆满书籍和装饰品的架子
同根 ornamental adj. · ornamentally adv. · ornamental n. · ornamentation n. · ornamentalist n.

• v. 装配
    If you mount an object on something, you fix it there firmly
例句
  • Her husband mounts the work on velour paper and makes the frame.
    她丈夫把作品装裱到丝绒纸上，又做了框架。
搭配
  • mount everest — 埃佛勒斯峰（喜马拉雅山主峰之一，中国称珠穆朗玛峰）
  • surface mount — 表面黏着方式
  • mount up — 增长；上升
  • mount qomolangma — 珠穆朗玛峰
同根 mounting adj. · mounted adj. · mounting n. · mounting v. · mounted v.

• v. （美观地）排列
    to arrange something in an attractive way
  • n. 陈列
    An array of objects is a collection of them that is displayed or arranged in a particular way.
真题
  • ...But an array of countries are rushing to assert greater influence here... 2016.12 阅读理解
  • ...They are a vital part of an array of data that we use to assess if we're doing well or doing badly... 2015.6 阅读理解
例句
  • make-up arrayed on the bathroom counter
    盥洗台上摆放整齐的化妆品
  • We visited the local markets and saw wonderful arrays of fruit and vegetables.
    我们参观了当地的市场，看到了漂亮地摆放着的水果蔬菜。
搭配
  • an array of — 一排；一批；大量
  • phased array — 相控阵；相位排列
  • antenna array — 天线阵
  • gate array — [计]门阵列；门数组

column1:
diversion
英 /daɪ'vɜːʃ(ə)n; dɪ-/ 美 /dəˈvɝʒən; dəˈvɝʃən; daɪˈvɝʒən; daɪˈvɝʃən/
[sound:yd_diversion_uk.mp3]
column2:
• n. 转移；改道；娱乐
    a change in the direction or use of something, or the act of changing it
助记 di(离开) ＋ vers(转) ＋ ion → 转开 → 转向， 转移
例句
  • A slight diversion in the road is causing major headaches for businesses along El Camino Real.
    马路上的一小段绕行道让国王大道沿街的商家十分头疼。
  • The party will make a pleasant diversion.
    晚会会是个很不错的消遣。
搭配
  • south-to-north water diversion — 南水北调
  • diversion tunnel — 导流洞；导流隧洞
  • river diversion — 导流；河流改道
  • trade diversion — 贸易转移，贸易转向；贸易多样化
同根 diverting adj. · diversionary adj. · divertingly adv. · diversionist n. · diverting v. · divert vi. · divert vt.

• v. 转变，改变，变换
    to change something into a different form, or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way
助记 con ＋ vert(转) → (使)转变
真题
  • ...Once large issuers convert together... 2015.6 阅读理解
  • ...are now offering to convert your magstripe card to a chip-and-PIN model... 2015.6 阅读理解
例句
  • a 19th-century converted barn
    由19世纪谷仓改建的房子
搭配
  • convert into — 使转变；把…转化成；折合
同根 convertible adj. · converted adj. · conversion n. · converter n. · convertible n. · converted v.

• n. 转变，变迁；过渡
    when something changes from one form or state to another
真题
  • ...who had led Nokia's transition from an industrial company to a technology giant... 2015.12 阅读理解
  • ...When you hear people speaking of making a rapid transition toward any type of energy... 2015.12 阅读理解
例句
  • Making the transition from youth to adulthood can be very painful.
    从青少年过渡到成年有时是一个非常痛苦的过程。
  • a society that is in transition
    一个正在转型的社会
搭配
  • transition period — 过渡时期
  • phase transition — 相变
  • transition temperature — [电]转移温度
  • transition metal — 过渡金属
同根 transitional adj. · transitive adj. · transit n. · transitive n. · transitivity n. · transit vi. · transit vt.

• adj. 专利的
    protected by a patent
  • n. 专利
    A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.
真题
  • ...they can set up the practice of giving premiums or issuing patent certificate to inventors... 2016.12 写作题
  • ...Have we really gotten to the point that planting a seed can lead to a high-stakes Supreme Court patent lawsuit... 2013.12 阅读理解
例句
  • a patent lock
    专利锁
  • He held a number of patents for his many innovations.
    他为他的许多革新申请了几项专利。
搭配
  • national patent — 国家专利
  • patent law — 专利法，专利权法
  • patent application — 专利申请书
  • patent protection — 专利保护
同根 patented adj. · patentee n.

• v. 抓住，掌握，攫
    to hold something tightly because you do not want to lose it
助记 和catch(v. 抓住)一起记忆
例句
  • She was clutching a bottle of champagne.
    她手里紧紧抓着一瓶香槟酒。
搭配
  • in the clutch — [口语]在关键时刻
  • electromagnetic clutch — 电磁离合器
  • clutch at — 抓住
  • friction clutch — 摩擦离合器

• v. 铸造（硬币）
    to make pieces of money from metal
真题
  • ...Every coin has two sides... 2015.12 写作题
搭配
  • gold coin — 金币；小钱
  • false coin — n. 假币
  • silver coin — 银币
  • copper coin — n. 铜币
同根 coinage n. · coiner n.

• v. 注射；注满；喷射
    to put liquid, especially a drug, into someone’s body by using a special needle
助记 in(进入) ＋ ject(扔) → 扔到里面 → 投入， 引入
例句
  • His son was injected with strong drugs.
    他的儿子被注射了强效的药。
同根 injectable adj. · injection n. · injector n. · injectable n.

• n. 贮藏；保管
    the process of keeping or putting something in a special place while it is not being used
真题
  • ...as around 75% of the local harvest goes to waste thanks to a lack of proper storage facilities... 2017.12 阅读理解
  • ...But Sadoway isn't alone in trumpeting energy storage as a missing link to a cleaner... 2016.12 阅读理解
例句
  • the storage of highly radioactive material
    高放射性材料的存放
  • storage costs
    保管费用
搭配
  • data storage — 数据存储
  • storage system — 存储系统；存储器存储系统
  • energy storage — 蓄能；能量储存；储能器
  • storage tank — 储油罐；储蓄槽
同根 stored adj. · store n. · storekeeper n. · stored v. · store vt.

• adj. 主要都市的
    relating or belonging to a very large city
  • n. （东正教和天主教的）大主教
    a metropolitan is an important priest in the Orthodox and Catholic Churches. He has authority over other priests and is in charge of a particular area.
真题
  • ...None of the chain’s stores in the Washington metropolitan area are to be closed... 2017.6 阅读理解
  • ...why the Salt Lake City metro area is one of the 100 largest metropolitan areas most likely to lift the fortunes of the poor and the Atlanta metro area is one of the least likely... 2015.12 阅读理解
例句
  • a metropolitan area of South Australia
    南澳大利亚的一个都市区
  • ...the Ukrainian Catholic representatives, Metropolitan Volodymyr and Bishop Sofron.
    乌克兰的天主教代表——弗拉基米尔大主教和索夫龙主教
搭配
  • metropolitan area — 大城市区域，大都市区；大都会区
  • metropolitan museum — 大都会博物馆
  • metropolitan police — 都市警察
  • metropolitan museum of art — 大都会艺术博物馆

• v. 逐出，排斥；喷射
    to make someone leave a place or building by using force
助记 e(出) ＋ ject(扔) → 被扔出来 → 逐出， 驱逐
例句
  • The demonstrators were ejected from the hall.
    示威者被赶出大厅。
  • Two engines cut out and the plane started to eject fuel as it lost height.
    两个发动机突然熄火，飞机在下降的同时开始喷出燃料。
同根 ejector n. · ejection n.

• n. 皱纹
    wrinkles are lines on your face and skin that you get when you are old
  • vt. 使起皱纹
    if you wrinkle a part of your face, or if it wrinkles, small lines appear on it
助记 眼睛一眨一眨(twinkle)都起皱纹(wrinkle)了
例句
  • Her face was a mass of wrinkles.
    她的脸上布满皱纹。
  • Alex wrinkled up her nose at the smell.
    闻到那股味道，亚历克丝皱起了鼻子。
搭配
  • wrinkle recovery — 褶皱回复；折痕回复力
  • wrinkle up — 使起皱纹
同根 wrinkled adj. · wrinkly adj. · wrinkly n.

• n. 轴，轴线
    the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns
助记 ax(斧头) ＋ is → 劈柴不照纹， 累死劈柴人 → 中心线
例句
  • The Earth rotates on an axis between the north and south poles.
    地球绕着南北两极之间的地轴自转。
搭配
  • principal axis — [物]主轴
  • central axis — 中心轴；中央轴
  • vertical axis — 垂直轴；纵轴
  • optical axis — 光轴；视轴

• n. 周年纪念日
    a date on which something special or important happened in a previous year
助记 anni(年) + vers(转) + ary → 每年都会转到的日子 → 周年(纪念日)
例句
  • Jack and Kim celebrated their twentieth wedding anniversary in January.
    1月，杰克和金庆祝了他们的结婚20周年纪念日。
搭配
  • wedding anniversary — 结婚纪念日；结婚周年纪念日
  • happy anniversary — 周年纪念快乐
  • silver anniversary — 二十五周年纪念日

• n. 周（边）；周长
    the border around an enclosed area such as a military camp
例句
  • ...the perimeter of the airport.
    …机场周边。
  • Calculate the perimeter of the rectangle.
    计算这个长方形的周长。
搭配
  • wetted perimeter — [地]湿周
  • perimeter blasting — 光面爆破；周边爆破；巷道周边爆破法

• n. 重要（性），重大意义
    importance
助记 con ＋ sequ(跟随) ＋ ence → 跟随其后 → 结果
真题
  • ...The Internet has become a shield in many ways， exempting us from the consequence we should take responsibility for even though we make dreadful and malicious comments sometimes... 2016.6 写作题
  • ...What is said to be the consequence of a shrinking population... 2013.12 阅读理解
例句
  • I don’t suppose it is of any consequence now.
    现在我觉得这事一点都无所谓了。
搭配
  • as a consequence — 因此，结果
  • in consequence — 因此；结果
  • as a consequence of — 因此；由于…的结果
  • in consequence of — 由于…的缘故
同根 consequent adj. · consequential adj. · consequently adv. · consequent n.

• n. 种类，类目；范畴
    a group of people or things that are all of the same type
真题
  • ...we also acknowledge that using race as a political or social category to study racism... 2016.12 阅读理解
  • ...there’s one category of worker that the economic disruption has been good for: nonhumans... 2012.12 阅读理解
例句
  • people in the over-45 age category
    属45岁以上年龄组的人
  • Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
    座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。
搭配
  • product category — 产品类别；产品目录；积范畴
  • first category — 第一纲
  • category theory — 范畴论
  • category management — 品类管理；类别管理
同根 categorical adj. · categorized adj. · categorial adj. · categorization n. · categorized v. · categorize vt. · categorise vt.

• n. 种，物种；种类
    a group of animals or plants whose members are similar and can breed together to produce young animals or plants
真题
  • ...300 species of fish and 700 species of coral... 2017.12 阅读理解
  • ...Qinghai lake offers many species an intermediate stop during their migration... 2017.12 文本题
例句
  • Seven species of birds of prey have been observed.
    已有七种猛禽被观察到。
  • pandas and other endangered species
    熊猫以及其他濒危物种
搭配
  • species diversity — 物种多样性；歧异度
  • species composition — 物种组成；种类成分
  • species richness — 物种丰富度；种繁富度
  • species abundance — 物种丰度
同根 speciation n. · speciate vi.

• n. 中间体；调解人
真题
  • ...Qinghai lake offers many species an intermediate stop during their migration... 2017.12 文本题
搭配
  • intermediate frequency — 中频
